title: Packaging delivery coordination
summary: [00:00-00:40] Sample purpose — Participant A asks about a sample run to check how the proposed cartons fit the product and its protective sleeve; Participant B discusses the supplier’s approach • [00:40-01:12] Drawing revision — Participant C says the sleeve measurements are still being checked; Participant A confirms that a revised drawing is needed before production • [01:12-01:47] Sample specification — Participant A agrees to twenty-four unprinted natural-board samples; Participant B confirms they can be cut from one sheet for the quoted sample charge • [01:47-02:34] Dispatch timing — Participant A expects the revised drawing Tuesday morning; Participant B anticipates dispatching the samples Thursday if the drawing arrives by noon, with delivery timing to follow through tracking • [02:34-03:03] Quality checks — Participant C will use the samples for fit and handling checks after arrival and explains that shipping performance will require a different test plan • [03:03-03:42] Later production — Participant A leaves final appearance and a larger production order for later; Participant B will separately investigate white material
